model: ROLEX Datejust 41 126334 (41 mm steel, white-gold fluted bezel, mint green dial, Cyclops date, Oyster bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Datejust 41 template (126331 Everose Rolesor / Jubilee slate Roman and 126333 Rolesor yellow / Jubilee slate change model, note, trace, dial_map, steel_map, emissions and what the BASELINE template section lists): case and lugs from the photo silhouette, polished flange + chamfer + 74 real flutes (148 flat facets with the photo's zig-zag in / out outline), domed crystal, Cyclops date lens, traced hand outlines, fluted crown and the three-column Oyster bracelet at the photo's joints; dial, indices, print, date numeral, rehaut engraving and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.215 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 905, lug bottom y 1980, crown rows take the mirrored left flank); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: boundary k = 0..147 counter-clockwise from 12 o'clock; long boundaries (odd k: one is exactly at 9 o'clock) reach r 17.41..20.06 mm, short ones 17.59..19.90 mm; flange 15.98..17.08 mm

lens.note: Cyclops: outline = trace.lens_mm (rim outer edge, barrel shaped, about 7.6 x 5.9 mm), rim chamfer 0.18 mm then a flat top inset 0.55 mm; shows the projected photo of the lens

hands.note: hands = traced photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons; the lume, black facets and polished edges stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Datejust crown (no guards): flutes x 1409..1459, cap to 1474, axis 0.52 mm below the pivot

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind. A Jubilee: columns outer / semi / centre / semi / outer, 4 boundaries per bounds row, pieces and z_semi per kind.

bracelet.note: Oyster bracelet: brushed outer links and a wider polished centre link. Joint rows (px, 22.215 px/mm, pivot (960, 1424)): outer top 752.5, ends 674.5 (rounded corners of the outer links) / 672 (centre link); outer bottom 2182 / 2369 / 2488, end 2527; centre top 867 / 726, end 672; centre bottom 2030 / 2240 / 2406 / 2503, end 2527; column lines x 859.5 / 1059 (top), 859 / 1059.5 (bottom). Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette (the bracelet tapers from 21.0 mm at the lugs).

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
